name: HITRUST Common Security Framework
description: HITRUST CSF v11.3.0 is a certifiable, scalable security and privacy controls framework consolidating HIPAA, ISO 27001, NIST SP 800-53, PCI DSS, GDPR, and other standards. Widely adopted in healthcare and increasingly in adjacent regulated industries. HITRUST CSF Certification is a recognized form of compliance attestation.
relationToCloudSecurity: Cloud service providers serving healthcare or HIPAA-covered customers commonly pursue HITRUST CSF Certification. Maps to many cloud-relevant control sets.
relationToAISecurity: HITRUST published HITRUST AI Security Assessment in 2024; HITRUST CSF v11+ began incorporating AI-related controls. Use HITRUST AI Security Assessment for current AI-specific evaluations.

Access requires a HITRUST licence. Since 2026-11-13 this public repository holds only this metadata stub. Correction 2026-11-13: an earlier version of this note already claimed that, but the full text and the structured controls had in fact been committed here since 2026-05-12.

current_extraction.notes: This describes the extraction held in the private dataset (dataset-private-laws-regulations-standards, same path); none of its files are in this public repository. Marker-extracted from HITRUST-published material. extract_hitrust_csf.py parses the marker markdown into 150 Control References across 13 Control Categories (00-13, with 04.0 not having leaf controls in this version). Repository holds the extraction artifacts only; full CSF requires a HITRUST license.
